title: Detlev Bronk named as an MJ12 member

tellings.quote: In fact, Detlev Bronc who is the president of the Rockefeller Foundation was named as one of the Majestic 12.

plain: A scientist named Detlev Bronk, whom Michels calls president of the Rockefeller Foundation, a large American charity that funds research, was listed as one of the Majestic 12. That is the name of a secret committee that disputed papers, the MJ12 documents, say managed the UFO question from 1947 on. Michels brings this up himself, citing those documents, in an episode asking whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a program to recover crashed UFOs, because it would tie respected establishment figures to such a group.
